purpose: Short T08 local desktop smoke for independent lobby/studio media, member redaction, room switching, and server rejection of forged room/identity/role controls.

topology.network: one local application over trusted HTTPS/WSS

tls.trust: local CA imported only into each isolated Firefox profile and passed to external WSS probes

syntheticSources.audio: per-room oscillator routed to AudioContext MediaStreamDestination; no hardware microphone
syntheticSources.screen: per-room solid-color canvas MediaStreamTrack returned by test-only getDisplayMedia replacement

limitations.accountsAndPrivateRoomEntry: not-implemented; server IDs identify a connection/participant only and do not verify a person
limitations.realDisplayCapture: not-tested; screen source is an injected canvas
limitations.durabilityAndMultiInstance: not-tested; room and relay state is process memory
